project_type: NestJS API + React (Vite) web-app + React (Vite) public site — pnpm monorepo
build_system: pnpm workspaces. Root scripts: `pnpm build:api` (nestjs build), `pnpm build:app` (vite), `pnpm build:public` (vite). TypeORM with autoLoadEntities:true so new entities are registered by their Module's TypeOrmModule.forFeature call — no separate entity registration needed.
test_framework: No test suite found. Verification is via tsc --noEmit.
build_command: pnpm build:all (or pnpm typecheck:api && pnpm typecheck:app)
test_command: pnpm typecheck:api && pnpm typecheck:app && pnpm typecheck:public
verification_instructions: 1. Run `pnpm typecheck:api` from monorepo root — must exit 0. 2. Run `pnpm typecheck:app` — must exit 0. 3. Run `pnpm typecheck:public` — must exit 0. 4. Run `pnpm build:all` as final check.
environment_constraints: Windows shell (PowerShell). Paths use backslashes in file system but forward slashes in TS imports. The pnpm workspace root is `c:\Amalgamate\Projects\Trends CORE Apps\MAKU`. Never restart any running dev server.
contribution_requirements: Each FEAT must leave the codebase in a buildable (tsc-clean) state. Commit on the current branch (do not push). Use conventional commit message format.
key_patterns: 1. NestJS module pattern: entity -> service -> controller -> module -> register in app.module.ts. 2. Decorator imports: `@Roles` from `../../shared/decorators/roles.decorator`, `@Public` from `../../shared/decorators/public.decorator`, `@CurrentUser` from `../../shared/decorators/current-user.decorator`. 3. Response shape: controller returns plain object; TransformInterceptor wraps to `{ data: <payload>, message: 'Success' }`. So `GET /feedlot` controller return value becomes `{ data: FeedlotAnimal[], message }` on the wire. 4. Frontend API calls: `apiClient.get<{ data: <inner>; message: string }>('/path')` then `res.data.data` is `<inner>`. 5. React Query hooks: query keys are string arrays, e.g. `['feedlot']`; mutation invalidates `{ queryKey: ['feedlot'] }`. 6. Zod + react-hook-form pattern for forms; `useForm` with `zodResolver`. 7. Modals: fixed overlay with `z-50`, white panel, close X button top-right — see `StaffPage.tsx` or `SuppliersPage.tsx` for exact classNames. 8. Toast notifications: `toast.success('title', 'subtitle')`, `toast.error(...)` from `../../../shared/store/toast.store`. 9. UserRole enum from `@maku/shared-types` — values: SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, FIELD_OFFICER, FINANCE_OFFICER, STAFF.
directory_structure: apps/api/src/modules/ — one directory per feature module. apps/web-app/src/modules/ — same feature grouping; each has pages/, hooks/, services/, and sometimes components/ and store/. apps/web-public/src/ — public marketing site with hooks/ and components/. packages/ — shared types (@maku/shared-types) and UI (@maku/ui).
